steps.en: OCMS rejects the request and marks it Rejected
steps.id: OCMS menolak request dan menandainya Rejected

steps.en: The hirer or driver particulars on the notice are left unchanged
steps.id: Particulars hirer atau driver di notice tidak diubah

steps.en: OCMS stores the date and time the email should be sent
steps.id: OCMS menyimpan tanggal dan jam email akan dikirim
steps.why_en: No place exists to store a schedule; nothing waits for a later time.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat menyimpan jadwal; tidak ada yang menunggu waktu nanti.

steps.en: The email goes out by itself at the scheduled date and time
steps.id: Email terkirim sendiri pada tanggal dan jam terjadwal
steps.why_en: The email is sent right away at submit, not at a scheduled time.
steps.why_id: Email langsung terkirim saat submit, bukan pada waktu terjadwal.

steps.en: Each email send is recorded with its result and time
steps.id: Setiap pengiriman email dicatat dengan hasil dan waktunya
steps.why_en: A record is kept, but its time is when the email was sent, not a chosen schedule.
steps.why_id: Catatan tersimpan, tetapi waktunya saat email dikirim, bukan jadwal pilihan.
